sonora_ca.name: Sonora
sonora_ca.obs_note: Sonora has no NWS observing station. The readings come from the Green Spring fire-weather station, 12 miles away and about 700 ft lower.

alerts.headline: Winter Weather Advisory issued November 19 at 1:40AM PST until November 19 at 7:00PM PST by NWS Reno NV
alerts.description:
* CHANGES...Snow amounts reflect remaining accumulations.

* WHAT...Snow. Additional snow accumulations up to 3 inches below
5000 feet, with 2 to 6 inches above 5000 feet, including foothill
areas and Virginia City. Locally up to 10 inches above 6000 feet.

* WHERE...Greater Reno-Carson City-Minden Area.

* WHEN...Until 7 PM PST this evening.

* IMPACTS...Plan on slippery road conditions. The hazardous
conditions will impact the Thursday morning and evening commutes.
